finding.summary: GitHub currently supports REST API versions 2026-03-10 and 2022-11-28; the older version has an end-of-support date of 2028-03-10. The existing pagination provenance gate accepted any date-shaped version, so an invented or retired version could be promoted.
finding.uncertainty: Supported versions can change; the policy observation must be refreshed and the allowlist updated through a reviewed commit.

fail_closed_conditions: legacy version after its support window

verification.scope: deterministic local tests against the exact committed source

falsification_route: Show that an API version absent from GitHub's supported-version list is accepted.
Show that 2022-11-28 remains accepted on or after 2028-03-10 without a newer policy observation.
Show that a stale or future-dated policy observation is accepted.
Refresh the primary source and demonstrate that the committed allowlist diverges from GitHub's supported-version table.
design_implication: Require github_api_version_policy_verified before pagination_provenance_verified evidence can enter R-021 reconciliation. Pin an explicitly supported X-GitHub-Api-Version header and retain the policy observation timestamp with the evidence bundle.
